latest_access_check.interpretation: Access confirmation only; it does not change source scope, recency class, citation restrictions or gate status.

search_gaps.query_scope: GOV.UK search for SACN vitamin K
search_gaps.result: No direct current SACN vitamin-K report identified; returned results were general SACN collection or other nutrient material.
No direct current SACN magnesium report identified; returned results were general SACN collection or unrelated nutrition material.
No direct current SACN zinc report identified; the results included the general SACN collection and an older 2008 zinc-related record, neither imported as a current nutrient-specific frame.

search_gaps.query_scope: GOV.UK search for COT folic acid tolerable upper level
search_gaps.result: No separate direct COT folic-acid upper-level report identified; two guessed official publication routes returned 404 and the search returned the current DHSC folic-acid guidance plus an older consultation response.

search_gaps.query_scope: GOV.UK search for current magnesium safety guidance
search_gaps.result: The official API resolved the current UKHSA route 'Magnesium: health effects and incident management', last updated 2024-11-26. It is restricted to chemical-exposure and incident-response context, not food supplements.

search_gaps.query_scope: GOV.UK search for current zinc safety guidance
search_gaps.result: The API resolved the older 2008 FCDO research-output record as a Journal of Nutrition model article about phytate effects on zinc reference intakes. It is not a current UK safety assessment, and the article states that experimental studies are required to test its predictions; no current nutrient-specific zinc safety framework was identified.

remaining_limits: These sources are population-level or regulatory frames and do not establish product form, bioavailability, efficacy, suitability, interaction clearance or dose approval.
The 2005, 2011, 2013, 2014 and 2022 scientific sources require recency and scope review before any later use.
The 2026 vitamin-E discussion paper is accessibly available for gap awareness but is explicitly not citable and cannot close any gate.
